mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL growth reverts below 2% within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increases within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO rebounds within the next two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous two months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or HOUST declines within the next two months.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a robust labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or both conditions are not met in the subsequent month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) growth is below 2% annualized over the previous quarter, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% & GDPC1 growth < 2% annualized in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or conditions are not met in the subsequent quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Retail and Food Services Sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS rebounds within the next two months.
